# Create Blocking Question on Obstacle

> Skill id: `create-blocking-question-on-obstacle`
> Generated from the baseline catalog. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/generate-plugin-skills.py`.

As deliberate last resort, create a linked blocking Question with structured information dump when hitting a hard informational obstacle on another Issue. Pause the original work.

**Owning agents:** research-agent, software-engineer

## Inputs

- Original blocked Issue
- Blockage details + partial work (never lost)

## Outputs

- New blocking Question

## Examples

- We are blocked on scope ambiguity for the dashboard Epic. Create blocking Question and pause.
